name: truck-loader

frames.best_why: Truck is fully clear with a lamp standing to its right; frame 1 has no passing lamp at all.

tagline: A little red delivery truck bounces along a road while street lamps roll past.
summary: A flat side-view delivery truck idles on a thin road line, dipping on its suspension while dashed markings and lamp posts slide behind it. It loops forever as a loading indicator.
appearance: A pale grey box trailer with a red cab, dark wheels and a small yellow headlight sits on a thin horizontal road line. Grey lamp posts slide across a near-black stage behind it.
behaviour: The truck body dips and rises on its suspension while the road dashes and lamp posts travel right to left on a loop. Motion runs continuously and never settles.
demo_content: Out for delivery heading, with order #48213 and a 2:00 to 4:00 pm delivery window
search_phrases: delivery truck driving across the screen
animated van with scrolling street lamps
little red truck moving on a road
use_when: A delivery, shipping or checkout screen needs a friendly loading graphic that says the order is on its way.
avoid_when: Light themes, since the truck's dark outlines and fixed red and grey fills need source edits to restyle.
customise: Only className is exposed. Truck colours, the 200x100 box, speeds and the road colour variable must be changed in the source CSS.
weight_why: A handful of SVG shapes moved by three short CSS keyframe loops.

a11y.note: Has a status role and a Loading label, but the endless loop ignores reduced-motion preferences.

issues: A lamp post passes in front of the truck in frame 4, breaking the depth illusion.
polish_why: Tidy flat illustration with smooth looping motion; the lamp overlap is a small flaw.
title: Truck Loader
